markets.IR: social impact, zero revenue under sanctions
markets.NL_250plus: reachable via department reports; ~3,700 orgs x 3,000 = ~11.1M EUR, outside projection
markets.NL_agency_workers: CBS 2024: 52.4% foreign-born; RO 31,700 + UA 19,120 + BG 15,900 = 66,720 not covered by current 9 languages; not converted to EUR

department_tier.option_recommended: base (A or D) + per extra reportable department (>=10 responses)
department_tier.note_k: higher k (up to 50) shrinks the number of sellable departments

site_package.source: persona research 26 Nov 2026 (recommendation, not Maryam's decision)
site_package.contents: survey+report, 1 work-redesign workshop, RI&E output (response rate, action plan, OR pack), month-6 pulse
site_package.build_up: survey tier (1950/2950) + workshop 1250 + 750 assumed for month-6 pulse and RI&E output

positioning_recommended.text: RI&E-ready PSA inventory + 90-day team work-redesign cycle; provable anonymity is the foundation, not the headline

channels.weak: insurers: prevention budgets mostly individual and arbodienst-gated

pending_business_impacts.what: Six-expert review fixes applied (security, privacy, legal wording, statistics, accessibility). RI&E/PSA overclaims softened on site and in the works-council pack. Open: fake-response risk (no invite tokens/App Check, R44), shared github.io origin without CSP/SRI (R45), instruments measure personal resources not work hazards so RI&E claims need a licensed working-conditions instrument (R46), commercial licences for 6 of 8 scales unconfirmed (R47), DPA art.28(3) annex (R53), signed psychologist partner agreement (R54), Gmail contact (R52). Strategy review recommends a 30-day build freeze and one paid pilot (e.g. EUR 1,500 per site) via an independent RI&E consultant, leading with multilingual logistics/staffing agencies, dropping horeca as lead; it estimates 50-70 h per EUR 5,000 project (plan assumes 20 h) and a 3-6 month direct sales cycle (plan assumes 4-8 weeks).
pending_business_impacts.why_it_matters: The 'RI&E-ready PSA inventory' positioning (positioning_recommended, H15 site package) is not deliverable with the current instruments; licence costs are unbudgeted; free pilots may not prove budget; unit economics and break-even rest on 20 h/project and short sales cycles; R44/R45/R47 add pre-pilot cost and time. These are review recommendations, not Maryam's decisions.
